title: Canonical ordinary module pullback commutes with the braiding, in oplax form
statement: For a condensed commutative coefficient ring Λ, schemes X,Y, and f:X→Y, give ordinary module pullback F=f* its canonical residueOrdinaryUpperStarMonoidal structure. For all module sheaves M,N on Y, F(β(M,N)) followed by δ_F(N,M) equals δ_F(M,N) followed by β(FM,FN).

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(5), Remark 6.8.15; formal tensor and counit normalization

proof.text: Cancel the epimorphism from the ambient tensor product to the relative tensor product. The tensorComparison_inv_π equation reduces compatibility to ambient sheaf pullback braiding. Transport the resulting lax braided structure along the coefficient pullback isomorphism. Cancel the invertible lax tensorator to obtain the oplax equation.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved API for the explicit named-functor tensor model; no new sorry.

    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ Y)) :
    letI := residueOrdinaryUpperStarMonoidal Λ f
    (f)^*⟦Λ⟧.map (β_ M N).hom ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (f)^*⟦Λ⟧ N M =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (f)^*⟦Λ⟧ M N ≫
        (β_ ((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.obj M) ((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.obj N)).hom
